workload.counter_scope: Logical test payload only; not physical device I/O

global_heap.scope: Global allocator usage including GUI and other tasks
global_heap.interpretation: A bounded run describes observed global heap behavior. It does not establish absence of leaks or attribute changes to EncFS.

limitations: This bounded run is not an endurance guarantee or proof of zero leaks.
Global heap samples include GUI and other tasks; they do not isolate EncFS.
Payload byte counters exclude metadata, alignment and other physical I/O.
Framebuffer hashes establish integrity; header checks specifically verify stress-time page selection, not every possible GUI interaction.
Power-loss and hardware fault recovery are not tested by this analysis.
